;;; Peer-shared pipe domain: real endpoints, public I/O and existing replay support.
(declare (standard-bindings) (extended-bindings))
(define (pipe-open kind cont)
  (call-with-values (vector-ref (vector open-vector-pipe open-string-pipe open-u8vector-pipe) kind) cont))
;; port's first declared field is its mutex (lib/_io#.scm, define-type port).
;; This observer checks actual construction; it is not a new runtime accessor.
(define (pipe-owner port) (##unchecked-structure-ref port 1 #f #f))
(define (shared-owner? a b) (and (mutex? (pipe-owner a)) (eq? (pipe-owner a) (pipe-owner b))))
(define (put kind value out)
  (case kind ((0) (write value out)) ((1) (write-char (integer->char value) out)) ((2) (write-u8 value out))))
(define (get kind in)
  (let ((value (case kind ((0) (read in)) ((1) (read-char in)) ((2) (read-u8 in)))))
    (if (and (= kind 1) (char? value)) (char->integer value) value)))
(define (with-pipe kind proc)
  (pipe-open kind (lambda (a b)
    (dynamic-wind (lambda () #f) (lambda () (proc a b))
      (lambda () (close-port a) (close-port b))))))
(define self (path-expand (car (command-line))))
(define (trace-tag) 'pipe-domain-trace)
(include "root-task-replay.scm")
(define (replay-pipe commands fault)
  (let ((at 0) (kind (if (null? commands) 0 (vector-ref (car commands) 0))))
    (define (bad op) (write (list 'root-task-result 'mismatch at op kind)) (newline) (exit 71))
    (with-pipe kind
      (lambda (out in)
        (let ((queue '()) (closed? #f))
          (for-each
            (lambda (row)
              (let ((op (vector-ref row 1)) (value (vector-ref row 2)))
                (if (not (shared-owner? out in)) (bad 4))
                (case op
                  ((0) (if (not closed?) (begin (put kind value out) (force-output out)
                                              (set! queue (append queue (list value))))))
                  ((1) (if (pair? queue)
                           (begin (if (not (equal? (get kind in) (car queue))) (bad 1))
                                  (set! queue (cdr queue)))))
                  ((2) (##gc) (if (= fault 1) (bad 2)))
                  ((3) (if (not closed?) (begin (close-output-port out) (set! closed? #t)))))
                (set! at (+ at 1)))) commands)
          (for-each (lambda (value) (if (not (equal? (get kind in) value)) (bad 1))) queue)
          (if (not closed?) (close-output-port out))
          (if (not (eof-object? (get kind in))) (bad 3)))))
    (write (list 'root-task-result 'pass at kind)) (newline) (exit 0)))
(define (timeout-exit kind)
  (with-pipe kind
    (lambda (out in)
      (let ((caught #f))
        (input-port-timeout-set! in 0 (lambda () (error "pipe timeout exit")))
        (with-exception-catcher (lambda (e) (set! caught #t)) (lambda () (get kind in)))
        (if (not caught) (error "timeout hook did not exit" kind))
        (input-port-timeout-set! in #f)
        (put kind 73 out) (force-output out)
        (if (not (= (get kind in) 73)) (error "timeout exit lost domain" kind))))))
(define (properties)
  (let ((seed 2081) (actions 0))
    (define (next n) (set! seed (modulo (+ (* seed 48271) 17) 2147483647)) (modulo seed n))
    (do ((kind 0 (+ kind 1))) ((= kind 3))
      (timeout-exit kind)
      (do ((history 0 (+ history 1))) ((= history 4))
        (let ((commands
                (append (list (vector kind 4 0))
                  (let loop ((n 32)) (if (= n 0) '()
                    (cons (vector kind (next 3) (+ 32 (next 90))) (loop (- n 1)))))
                  (list (vector kind 3 0)))))
          (set! actions (+ actions (length commands)))
          (let ((result (trial commands 0)))
            (if (signature result) (error "pipe domain history" result (shrink commands 0 (signature result))))))))
    (let* ((commands (append (make-list 6 '#(0 4 0)) '(#(0 2 0)) (make-list 6 '#(0 4 0))))
           (failure (trial commands 1)) (wanted (signature failure)) (minimal (shrink commands 1 wanted)))
      (if (not (and (equal? wanted '(2 0)) (= (length minimal) 1)
                    (one-minimal? minimal 1 wanted) (not (signature (trial minimal 0)))))
          (error "pipe replay/shrink control" failure minimal))
      (with-output-to-file "pipe-domain.trace" (lambda () (write (list (trace-tag) 1 minimal 0)) (newline)))
      (if (signature (trial-file "pipe-domain.trace")) (error "serialized pipe replay")))
    (delete-file input-file)
    (write (list 'PIPE-DOMAIN-PBT-PASS 'histories 12 'actions actions 'timeout-exits 3
                 'shrink-from 13 'shrink-to 1 'control 'observation-mutation)) (newline)))
(define (parallel)
  (if (< (##current-vm-processor-count) 2) (error "two processors required"))
  (do ((kind 0 (+ kind 1))) ((= kind 3))
    (with-pipe kind
      (lambda (out in)
        (if (not (shared-owner? out in)) (error "split pipe owner" kind))
        (let ((writer (make-thread (lambda ()
                       (if (not (= (##current-processor-id) 1)) (error "writer processor"))
                       (do ((i 0 (+ i 1))) ((= i 256))
                         (put kind (+ 32 (modulo i 90)) out) (force-output out)
                         (if (= (modulo i 16) 0) (##gc)))
                       (close-output-port out) 256))))
          (##thread-pin! writer (##processor 1))
          (thread-start! writer)
          (do ((i 0 (+ i 1))) ((= i 256))
            (if (not (= (get kind in) (+ 32 (modulo i 90)))) (error "pipe order" kind i)))
          (if (not (eof-object? (get kind in))) (error "pipe close" kind))
          (if (not (= (thread-join! writer) 256)) (error "writer completion" kind))))))
  (display "PIPE-DOMAIN-PARALLEL-PASS kinds=3 values=768 writer-processor=1\n"))
(define (cost)
  (write (cons 'PIPE-DOMAIN-COST
    (##exec-stats (lambda ()
      (do ((i 0 (+ i 1))) ((= i 4096) i)
        (with-pipe (modulo i 3)
          (lambda (out in) (put (modulo i 3) 73 out) (force-output out)
            (if (not (= (get (modulo i 3) in) 73)) (error "pipe cost result")))))))))
  (newline) (display "PIPE-DOMAIN-COST-PASS pairs=4096\n"))
(let ((args (cdr (command-line))))
  (cond ((null? args) (properties))
        ((equal? args '("--parallel")) (parallel))
        ((equal? args '("--cost")) (cost))
        ((and (= (length args) 2) (equal? (car args) "--replay"))
         (let ((trace (with-input-from-file (cadr args) read)))
           (if (not (and (list? trace) (= (length trace) 4) (eq? (car trace) (trace-tag)) (= (cadr trace) 1)))
               (error "unsupported pipe trace" trace))
           (replay-pipe (caddr trace) (cadddr trace))))
        (else (error "pipe test arguments" args))))
